groups.defect: isAccessTokenId matcher in AssertEvents reads the grant shortcut with the off-by-one substring(3,5) instead of substring(4,6), and its equality check is inverted (the accompanying comment also gives the wrong position), so it never actually checks the grant type.
groups.rationale: Every member points at the same matcher line and reports the same wrong offset and inverted check. s_1afe381d also mentions the misleading comment, but that comment is the source of the same offset bug.

groups.defect: In the AccessTokenContext constructor, the line meant to check rawTokenId for null checks grantType a second time, so rawTokenId is never validated.
groups.rationale: All members report the same copy-paste mistake on line 73, and the same one-line edit fixes it.

groups.defect: The OAuth2GrantTypeFactory.getShortcut javadoc describes '3-letter' shortcuts, but the decoder hard-codes 2-character shortcuts and a 6-character prefix; nothing checks shortcut length, and the javadoc needs to say 2 characters.
groups.rationale: Both report the same mismatch between the documented shortcut length and the fixed 2-character decoding. One points at the decoder and also asks for length validation; the other points at the javadoc.
